name: Amanatsu Purin
source:
She is the poster girl for the okonomiyaki restaurant "Koteko-tei". Inheriting her parents' downtown spirit, she has a go-getter attitude towards everything. She wakes the protagonist up every morning and has him try various "amazing okonomiyaki" that she makes as prototypes to improve her own okonomiyaki-making skills.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%98%9F%E3%81%AE%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%90%E3%81%8F%E3%82%93]Wikipedia[/url]]
